# CostEstimator

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.CostEstimator`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Estimates cardinality (row count) for query plan nodes using heuristic selectivity factors. Uses entity record counts from metadata when available, falling back to defaults.
